strategy.hypothesis: The existing low-vol carry strategy ranks on a simple weighted sum of low volatility and relative strength. I improve it by requiring that the relative strength is not just positive but also recently improving, capturing the early stage of institutional accumulation before the move becomes crowded. This refinement targets the same mechanism—underfollowed stable performers—but adds a timing filter that reduces exposure to names whose strength is already fully reflected, improving the carry's sustainability.
strategy.name: low_vol_relative_strength_carry_v1_improved
